summary.headline: Planetary Years of the Alcochoden
summary.text: Chapter IV explains how planets add to or subtract from the Alcochoden’s years, giving a table of greater, middle, and lesser years for Saturn, Jupiter, Mars, the Sun, Venus, Mercury, and the Moon in angular, succedent, and cadent places. It then describes benefic conjunctions and trine or sextile aspects as sources of added years, months, or days.
